origin.description: Combine data frames that do not share every column.

arguments.name: pages
arguments.text: A list of data frames. None is dropped.

origin.details: The R function calls vctrs::vec_rbind. Suggests vctrs; it is not an Import.
origin.example:
x <- data.frame(foo = c(1, 2), bar = c(TRUE, FALSE))
y <- data.frame(foo = 3, col = "blue")
z <- rbind_pages(list(x, y))
cat(paste(z$foo, z$bar, z$col, sep = ":", collapse = "|"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Columns are the union, in first-seen order. A missing cell is NA.

arguments.name: pages
arguments.text: A list of data frames. None is dropped.

translation.details: The simple column-union case is implemented here. Nested frames are not bound in this pass.
